title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Thomas Jefferson University
description: Ten currently documented food stops around Jefferson’s Center City campus, selected for later evening or overnight hours and under-21 access.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Chestnut
cards.subtitle: 1037 Chestnut St · Center City
cards.notes: Use the all-day-hours listing when an overnight food option is needed near the campus core; confirm your order method before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour, counter-service option on Chestnut Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists both dine-in and drive-thru service at 1037 Chestnut Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 1614 Chestnut
cards.subtitle: 1614 Chestnut St · Center City
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading west on Chestnut; its listed dine-in hours include service until midnight on Tuesday.
cards.short_summary: A Chestnut Street taco stop with midnight listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 1614 Chestnut Street lists Tuesday dine-in hours from 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Tuesday dine-in service until 12:00 AM; verify other-day hours before visiting.

cards.title: Shake Shack Midtown Village
cards.subtitle: 105 S 12th St · 12th & Chestnut
cards.notes: Use the official order options for pickup or dine-in, and plan around the later Friday and Saturday closing time on the location page.
cards.short_summary: Burgers, chicken, hot dogs, and frozen custard near 12th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack lists its Midtown Village location at 105 South 12th Street and lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in, pickup, and delivery; Friday and Saturday close at 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Wendy’s Until 2 AM
cards.subtitle: 1515 Chestnut St · Center City
cards.notes: Keep this address handy for a later counter-service meal; the operator lists the same 2 AM restaurant closing time across the week.
cards.short_summary: A Chestnut Street Wendy’s with consistently late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for 1515 Chestnut Street lists restaurant hours of 6:30 AM–2:00 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours until 2:00 AM every day.

cards.title: Bonchon in Chinatown
cards.subtitle: 1020 Cherry St · Chinatown
cards.notes: For a later sit-down or takeout meal, use the Cherry Street location page and note its 2 AM closing time on most listed days.
cards.short_summary: Korean fried chicken and Asian-fusion food with late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonchon’s official page lists its Philadelphia restaurant at 1020 Cherry Street, open until 2:00 AM Monday through Saturday and until 11:00 PM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 2:00 AM Monday–Saturday and 11:00 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Ishkabibble’s Original
cards.subtitle: 337 South St · South Street
cards.notes: Walk or arrange transport to the original South Street shop for a late sandwich stop; Friday and Saturday hours are listed through midnight.
cards.short_summary: The original Ishkabibble’s location with sandwiches and fries.
cards.evidence_claim: Ishkabibble’s official site identifies 337 South Street as the original location and lists Friday–Saturday hours from 9:30 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 12:00 AM; Sunday–Thursday close at 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Ishkabibble’s II
cards.subtitle: 517 South St · South Street
cards.notes: Choose the second South Street location when you want the listed larger seating setup, and use the posted midnight weekend closing time.
cards.short_summary: A second Ishkabibble’s location with larger seating listed by the operator.
cards.evidence_claim: Ishkabibble’s official site identifies Ishkabibble’s II at 517 South Street as the location with large seating and lists Friday–Saturday hours until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 12:00 AM; Sunday–Thursday close at 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Masala Kitchen Rittenhouse
cards.subtitle: 2004 Chestnut St · Rittenhouse Square
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday evening meal, place an order before the stated last-call buffer and use the operator’s current location page for timing.
cards.short_summary: Indian food at a Chestnut Street location with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Masala Kitchen’s Rittenhouse location page lists Friday and Saturday hours until 12:00 AM and says final eat-in/takeout orders are taken 15 minutes before closing.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday close at 12:00 AM; the operator says last eat-in/takeout orders are 15 minutes before closing.

cards.title: 15th St Pizza & Cheesesteak
cards.subtitle: 254 S 15th St · Center City
cards.notes: Use the counter’s daily 5 PM–3 AM window for slices, pies, or cheesesteaks, and confirm pickup timing if ordering a whole pie.
cards.short_summary: A Center City pizza-and-cheesesteak counter with daily 3 AM hours.
cards.evidence_claim: 15th St Pizza & Cheesesteak’s official site lists its address as 254 South 15th Street and states it is open daily from 5 PM until 3 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily hours of 5:00 PM–3:00 AM; whole pies require advance pickup ordering and are listed through midnight.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Arch
cards.subtitle: 801 Arch St · near Chinatown
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page for carryout or delivery and rely on its listed 1 AM daily closing time when planning a later pizza order.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, wings, pasta, and desserts with daily 1 AM listed service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official page for 801 Arch Street lists delivery and carryout hours from 10:00 AM to 1:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists delivery and carryout hours until 1:00 AM daily.
